data.gist: At 8 weeks, both treatments significantly reduced medial subchondral trabecular separation versus PBS (p=0.0340, 0.0246), but bone volume fraction and trabecular thickness did not differ; lateral compartment was unchanged.
data.plain: 3D X-ray imaging of the shin bone confirmed the osteoarthritis surgery worked in all animals. Saline-treated joints trended toward sparser bone struts beneath the cartilage; both treatments significantly reduced the gaps between struts, but other bone measures showed no significant group differences, and the outer half of the joint was unaffected.
